stem.text: The first column in the table gives four examples of work being done. The second column gives more detail of the action.

A.text: a girl dives from a diving board into a swimming pool; work is done by the girl against the gravitational field as she falls

B.text: a man pushes a car along a level road; work is done by the man against friction

C.text: an electron is accelerated towards a positively charged plate; work is done on the electron by the electric field of the plate

D.text: a piston is pushed outwards as a gas expands; work is done on the atmosphere by the gas
